summary: The project explores the scientific and historical significance of equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars following various space exploration missions. It examines spacecraft, landers, rovers, scientific instruments, and other mission hardware, including Apollo descent stages, ALSEP experiments, Lunar Roving Vehicles, Surveyor landers, Viking landers, Pathfinder, Spirit, Opportunity, Curiosity, Perseverance, Ingenuity, and InSight. The project aims to understand the purpose, functioning, achievements, and present status of these objects while highlighting their contributions to planetary science and the evolution of space exploration. It also emphasises how seemingly abandoned equipment continues to serve as a lasting record of humanity's technological progress, scientific curiosity, and exploration beyond Earth.
details: To complete our project we referred to different links available on the Nasa website which solidified our idea. This was followed by the creation of a website which enables the user to view, click, read through as well as listen to the stories of various equipment discarded on the moon and the mars. In addition to this, we created a comic which was intended to portray the story of these equipment in a far more interesting manner. Through this process we made use of AI tools and other resources.
